question: Define linear, surface and volume charge densities. Write their SI units.

options.A:

$\sigma=\frac{q}{A}$, unit $\text{C m}^{-2}$
$\rho=\frac{q}{V}$, unit $\text{C m}^{-3}$
options.B:
$\lambda=\frac{q}{A}$, unit $\text{C m}^{-2}$
$\sigma=\frac{q}{V}$, unit $\text{C m}^{-3}$
$\rho=\frac{q}{l}$, unit $\text{C m}^{-1}$
options.C:
$\lambda=ql$, unit $\text{C m}$
$\sigma=qA$, unit $\text{C m}^{2}$
